verdict.rationale: Turso's official MCP integration lets any MCP-capable AI agent manage the Cloud account (organizations, databases, groups) and run SQL on the user's behalf without copying API tokens, so natural-language operation works through an external agent. It is not a first-party natural-language interface, and the only evidence is the vendor's own docs page. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language/text-to-SQL interface in the dashboard or CLI, detail on the MCP tool coverage and its limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
